entities.summary: Razi Mousavi was an Iranian military officer who served in the IRGC's Quds Force. He was killed by an Israeli airstrike in Sayyidah Zaynab, Rif-Dimashq, Syria during the Gaza war. At the time of his death, Mousavi was described as Iran's most influential military commander in Syria.
